div.div: Eight pillars, booking first. Floor plans matter for three things only: turning a drawing into a bookable inventory, keeping identity across revised drawings (RevisionMapping), and drawing a recognisable map, so walls, doors and windows are render layers of a revision, not domain entities. Allocation is a versioned event per cycle; Rules govern allocation, booking and check-in. References to Person, Group and Role are written in the cards (→). Each relation is coloured by the pillar it starts from. Grey dashed = spaceweave-owned, not offered by any surveyed vendor.
